display_name: Phase1 类别条件候选与冻结基座核验恢复网络
description: 源域训练类别后验与类别条件受限波形候选，冻结 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL 核验并保守回退。
authorization: 用户要求大胆研发不同于另一个对话的星地恢复网络；只看 Phase1 地面训练测试集；地面基座 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；每个星地视图相对同一冻结基座 clean 损失不超过 3 个百分点。

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI Python/Torch, FP32, TF32 off; original Phase1 Tri-SIG-TIME immutable release

data.representation: Phase1 source paired received and clean IQ, frozen DURA and Tri-SIG-TIME SSL features
data.label_map_ref: Phase1 six TX classes; hidden throughout restorer training
data.tx_sets_ref: Six original classes; no TX labels in restorer training
data.validation_ref: Existing complete R07 source cache, IDs compared with Tri-SIG-TIME source contract
data.support_query_ref: Phase1 original fixed cross_rx126000 and cross_both42000; no support
data.leo_config_ref: R07 2.462 GHz source views and Phase1 six fixed practical test views
data.target_panel: 168000 Phase1 physical records x seven views
data.actual_training_labels: 6300 legal L_s labels; confident F(clean) pseudo-labels for U_s; no U_s labels, V or test IQ
data.augmentation: Source 20 views then repeat first 10; random order with 25% clean identity

permissions.regime: Phase1 L_s labels and L_s/U_s source IQ; frozen DURA and Tri-SIG-TIME SSL; no U_s labels/V/test during training
permissions.query_use: Frozen per-record received IQ, DURA and F only; no clean or truth at inference
permissions.claim_scope: Previously observed single-seed Phase1 development test, not blind

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen DURA E20 and Tri-SIG-TIME SSL E50; new zero-output class-conditional Transformer
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: DURA original 7/63/30 source-only metadata and pinned release; F exact original checkpoint ancestry and matching L_s/U_s IDs; DURA SHA bound into field checkpoint
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Both inherited Phase1 models are source-only and frozen; generation field from scratch
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed E30; no target-dependent model selection

execution.gpu_policy: CPU real F/DURA L_s smoke; shared lock; at most two same-user restoration workers and two same-user compute processes per GPU; >=12000 MB; GPU B128 smoke then fresh E30 and predictions
execution.stop_rule: ID/label/IQ mismatch, smoke failure, nonfinite gradient, resource ambiguity, frozen weight change or incomplete predictions preserves artifacts; no automatic retry or performance-based stop

metric_names: Tri-SIG-TIME raw clean, per-scene raw and restored accuracy, macro F1 and clean-relative gap
dimensions: 168000 Phase1 ground test physical records x seven views
metrics_plan.targets_ref: Each of six restored practical scenes within 3 percentage points of same reader raw clean; restored clean degradation at most 1 percentage point

notes: 输入只有接收 IQ、冻结 DURA 输出及冻结地面 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL 对 DURA 的特征和类别分数。输出类别后验与六个类别条件候选；单次只选一个类别候选。
仅使用 6300 条合法 L_s 真标签及 F(clean) 置信度至少 0.95 的 U_s 伪目标。L_s 物理 ID 与源 IQ 已对齐校验；不读取 U_s 标签、V 或测试 IQ 训练。
源训练时对有效目标和 DURA 决策不一致的样本运行 12 步冻结 F 的输入梯度投影，半径为 DURA 波形 L2 的 5%；仅达到目标类的扰动用于蒸馏，其余候选对齐 DURA。此 oracle 使用源训练信息，不用于推理。
预测时后验置信度至少 0.95、后验类与 DURA 的 F 类不同、且候选的冻结 F 类等于后验类，三条件同时满足才接受候选；否则保留 DURA。5% 上限和 F 的确认均不保证物理保真或真实性能提升。
固定 E30、14790 更新、20 视图重复前 10 视图、25% clean 身份输入。CPU 两条及 GPU 128 条真实 L_s 权重 smoke 后丢弃临时权重，正式重新初始化。七视图预测全部固定后才读取测试真值。
该 Phase1 测试此前已经观察，属于单随机种子开发测试，非独立盲测。报告逐场景相对 clean 原始准确率的百分点与相对百分比下降，另报告 clean 防护。

rows.method: Bounded class-specific proposals, source input-oracle distillation and frozen F verification gate
rows.purpose: Learn independent source target posterior and candidate waveforms while retaining original anchor if verification fails
rows.seed_notes: Model 2026092701, order 2026110104, training noise 2026110105, fixed inference noise template 2026110103; existing Phase1 split and views
rows.scenario: Phase1 R07 L_s/U_s training; fixed Phase1 clean and six practical received views
rows.budget_ref: E30 x63000 B128 14790 updates; 6300 L_s; U_s pseudo >=0.95; oracle 12 input steps 5% L2; verified posterior gate >=0.95; 25% clean
